title: Contact Whirl Curves in Sasakian Lorentzian 3-Manifolds
summary: We introduce and study \emph{contact whirl curves} in three-dimensional Lorentzian contact manifolds, with emphasis on the Sasakian setting. This notion refines the concept of whirl curves by encoding the interaction between the adapted frame of a curve and the ambient contact structure through the Reeb vector field. For non-geodesic unit-speed contact whirl curves, we derive a differential equation governing the torsion in terms of the Frenet invariants and the contact data.
